name: chrysaki-t3-stats
description: Writes the stats of each session to a JSON file and serves them on a local web page

dataDir.title: Data folder
dataDir.description: Folder for the session files. Empty means the .cache/chrysaki-t3-stats folder in the home folder.

port.title: Port
port.description: The local port of the stats page. The server binds 127.0.0.1 only.

serve.title: Start the server
serve.description: on starts the local page server at session start. off skips it.
